recent.text: The #Pistons also added that Ebuka Okorie sustained a left oblique strain during his G League assignment with the Cruise and will be reevaluated in two weeks. Taurean Prince underwent successful right knee arthroscopy on Nov. 18 and will be reevaluated in four weeks.

recent.quoted_text: The #Pistons announced that Jalen Duren has been assigned to the Motor City Cruise for practice on Wednesday as part of his return-to-play process from a right hamstring strain. In addition, Duncan Robinson is progressing from a left quad strain and is considered day-to-day.
